extraction_notes: Digitised main-text performance panels Figure 2a, 2d, and 2e. Figure 2b and 2c plot cumulative NH3 synthesis amount rather than rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF, so they were not encoded. Figure 4 panels are Arrhenius/reaction-order plots and were skipped according to the instructions. Characterisation figures were skipped. In Figure 2e the caption notes dotted lines as a second trial; the dotted replicate traces are too small/overlapped for reliable separate digitisation here, so only the clearly readable main marker series were recorded.
